BiblicalUsage: A sheepfold is the word for an enclosure, a fold for the flock — and it appears once, in a promise of gathering. In Micah 2:12 the Lord says, I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee, and I will surely gather the remnant of Israel, and put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold. The fold is the picture, and the gathering is the promise. This is a different word from the town of Bozrah, though the English spells them alike.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sheep of Bozrah is one of the tenderest pictures in the prophets: the remnant gathered, put together, safe in the fold.
